set.body:
Scope: modules/mvpa AxisRef/ReindexingLeg and modules/response adapters.

Deliverable: Express reusable axes and reindexing using locus4s and Resample4s contracts. Translate to response DomainId/OrderedIndices only in the downstream response adapter.

Acceptance:
- Candidate MVPA axis/reindex APIs expose no response types.
- Repeated draws preserve occurrence identity and order; unique selection checks still reject forbidden duplicates.
- Response-to-MVPA specimen preserves source lineage, exact alignment and scoped access on JVM/JS.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U1: Remove response-specific types from MVPA axes
